title: The Christ with the bridesister, moisture of light, born of an ensouled virgin, repentant sophia, departed to the plane of buddhi
html_source:
Though not directly quoting it, these sentences refer to the theosophical text of HP Blavatsky Isis Unveiled and the recently discovered text Pistis Sophia (Elliot, B. Gose, Jr Joyce’s Goddesses of Generation, p164 James Joyce : the Centennial Symposium).

Sophia was wisdom personified in Hellenic cultures and transferred into early Christian mysticism in gnostic philosophy whereby they believers followed the spirit of Christ and vilified the material world.

Pistis Sophia, a 3rd century text is very light heavy
